senses.label: a

senses.gloss: attached to, addicted to, in the habit of.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:23">Lam. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>הוה צמיד עיית קינדלוי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>הוה מסדרא וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:2:3">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוה עביד</he>) made it a habit to prepare his lights on Friday &c. (v. <cite ref="P00374"><he>עוּת</he></cite> ch.).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:9">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>הות צמידא אמרה נכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="R00576"><he>צְמִידָה</he></cite>) was addicted to evil talk.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 34:4">Targ. Ez. XXXIV, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 34:16">16</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 53a:7">B. Bath. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>דצ׳ לה מיא</he> (ed. Pes. a. oth. <he>דצאמת</he>, v. <cite ref="R00602"><he>צְמַת</he></cite>) he retained (dammed) the water for the benefit of the field, opp. <cite ref="T00327"><he>ארוח</he></cite> let the water spread.

senses.gloss: to bind up, heal, mend. Part. pass. מְצַמַּד.
units: Ab. Zar. 55ᵃ דאזלי כי מתברי … מְצַמְּדֵי who go (to an idolatrous temple) broken (crippled), and come out healed; Yalk. Ex. 289 מצמידי (corr. acc., or מִיצַמְּדֵי Ithpe.).

<cite ref="Berakhot 22b:15">Ber. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ חצביה דר״נ</he> R. N.’s pitcher has been mended (the rule he laid down is restored again), opp. <he>אתבר</he>, v. <cite ref="H01496"><he>חַצְבָּא</he></cite>.
